settings.estimator: ordered logit (primary M1 of severity.py), weighted maximum likelihood in the same raw parameterization
settings.class_probabilities: moderate prior, dependence fixed at 0 (audit primary)
settings.within_draw_variance: rider-clustered sandwich H^-1 (sum_i U_i U_i') H^-1
settings.pooling: Rubin's rules on the raw parameter vector, Barnard-Rubin df
settings.ame: severity.average_marginal_effects, 1000 Krinsky-Robb draws from the pooled mean and total variance (EL) or the sandwich (alternatives)

weight_definition.expected_likelihood: w_ic = pi_c p_K(k_i|c) p_N(n_i|c) / sum_c' pi_c' p_K(k_i|c') p_N(n_i|c'); l = sum_i sum_c w_ic log P(Y=c|x_i)
weight_definition.note: w depends on the record only through its (KABCO, narrative indicator) cell, so there are twenty distinct weight vectors; they are listed in audit_final.json. w is a function of the coded KABCO level that M1 models.

weighted_likelihood_verification.reference: statsmodels OrderedModel continued from the severity.py M1 optimum with BFGS gtol 1e-9
